text:
ani: hey team, getting alerts for repeated kernel tx_retries on host-rack-101 (us-west-3). Several fractional dedicated slices hit fallback routing during the 03:40 UTC window.

chetan: seen it. quick grafana: https://grafana/redwood/d/egress?var-host=host-rack-101&from=now-1h

mika: any link errors vs vf scheduling? paste ethtool and a short ifstat?

ani: ifstat snapshot:
```
eth0  tx 920Mbps rx 110Mbps errors 0 drops 0
eth1  tx 60Mbps  rx 8Mbps   errors 95 drops 12
```

ani: eth1 carries tenant-heavy VFs; errors spike when tenant R runs its fanout.

ryan: infra-bot: created incident INC-9999 and notified oncall. :rotating_light:

infra-bot: [AUDIT] INC-9999 opened by ani (priority P2).

chetan: mitigation options: 1) ephemeral steer tenant R to warm-dedicated-usw3-highcost for 20m, 2) per-vf egress throttle on vf2, 3) mark host as "vf-constrained" to avoid new multi-tenant placements. Thoughts?

mika: prefer (2) first to avoid cross-pool data transfer. Throttle snippet:
```
tc qdisc replace dev vf2 root tbf rate 300mbit burst 64k latency 100ms
```

ani: running throttle + pcap capture now. infra-bot: audit entry.

infra-bot: [AUDIT] tc throttle applied by ani on vf2 rate=300mbit TTL=1200

ryan: costs: if throttle fails and we steer, finance-bot will post delta. @finance FYI spare pool is ~x2.6.

finance: noted. estimated incremental cost for 20m steer: ~$1.10.

chetan: initial observation T+3m: neighbor p95 improved ~38%, eth1 errors steady but no additional fallbacks. Throttle seems to help.

mika: add telemetry hook to log per-slice KV cache regen events and per-VF IRQ counts every 10s for the next 30m so we can correlate amplification.

ani: will attach pcap/irq snapshot to INC-9999 and add runbook step: "if per-vf rx_errors > 30 in 5m -> apply per-vf throttle, monitor 10m, if still unstable -> steer and tag host vf-constrained."

chetan: long-term engineering note: evaluate SR-IOV strict carveouts for hosts with label vf-sensitive=true or invest in NICs with better MSI-X scaling. Need CAPEX/OPEX comparison. I'll open a short RFC.

ryan: agree. tagging @finance for modeling. For now leave throttle TTL=20m and monitor.

infra-bot: [NOTICE] throttle TTL will expire in 20m unless extended. Monitoring window started.

ani: thanks all. will follow up with artifacts in the ticket. :thumbsup:
